summary: Iter 15 — Frontend-only mobile responsiveness verification for ALL vendor pages under /app. Mobile (390x844) and Desktop (1920x800) tested with kamal@thedigisparrow.com (exempt). MOBILE: ✅ Hamburger top bar (vendor-mobile-menu-btn) opens slide-out drawer (vendor-sidebar slides from x=-260 to x=0); ✅ overlay (vendor-mobile-overlay) appears at 50% black; ✅ closes via X (vendor-mobile-close), overlay tap, AND nav-link click (verified nav-bot route changes and sidebar returns to x=-260); ✅ EVERY vendor route renders with NO horizontal page overflow (scrollWidth == clientWidth == 390 on /app, /app/bot, /app/channels, /app/appointments, /app/sales, /app/analytics, /app/billing, /app/settings, /app/referrals, /app/inbox); ✅ Inbox single-pane behavior: list shown initially with m-filter-all/m-filter-open/m-filter-resolved/m-channel-filter all visible, tapping a thread switches to detail (thread-messages visible, m-filter-all hidden, inbox-mobile-back visible) with NO page overflow, tapping back returns to list (m-filter-all visible again); ✅ Sales /app/sales prospects: sales-lists-sidebar stacks above content (x=16, y=312, w=358 — full-width, not side-by-side); ✅ Mobile Appointments table is 1093px wide but wrapped in overflow-x-auto container (parentW=358) — scrolls horizontally within container, no page overflow. DESKTOP REGRESSION: ✅ Sidebar fixed left column at x=0 w=260 h=800; ✅ vendor-mobile-menu-btn hidden; ✅ sidebar-collapse-btn collapses to w=64; ✅ sidebar-expand-btn restores to w=260; ✅ Inbox 3-pane confirmed (filters column + threads list + conversation detail visible simultaneously, screenshot verified); ✅ Desktop hides m-filter-all and inbox-mobile-back as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing (not related to this iteration's responsiveness work): React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' still emits on every page that loads SalesAssistant.jsx WaComposer template <select>. Carried over from iter 14. Cosmetic dev-only.

VendorLayout.jsx uses md: breakpoint (768px) for sidebar transition while pages use sm:p-8 (640px) for padding. Inconsistent breakpoints could be confusing at 640-768px tablet range — though within review-request scope this works correctly at 390px and 1920x800. Consider standardizing on one breakpoint family (lg: per Inbox.jsx) for a more cohesive responsive contract.
